basics.name: Jose Ramirez Mora
basics.label: Staff Software Engineer
basics.summary: Staff engineer with 15+ years building the platforms product teams depend on: frontend architecture, design systems, data access and developer experience. I work across team boundaries, turning duplicated, hard-to-change systems into shared foundations, from monolith migrations and GraphQL data layers to design systems adopted across multiple teams.
basics.tagline: Staff Software Engineer building the platforms product teams ship on — design systems, data access, frontend architecture and developer experience — turning sprawling, hard-to-change products into fast, reliable systems teams enjoy building on.

work.name: Personio
highlights: Migrated my domain's data access off legacy REST onto the company-wide GraphQL layer: 5+ entities, 20+ endpoints retired, done incrementally alongside feature work with no dedicated project. Ended the dual data-access pattern that was driving architectural drift.
Defined and own the frontend integration model for company-wide group management, now reused across 4+ product domains.
Leading and building data-connected design-system components that give product teams one consistent, ready-to-use implementation, reducing duplication, stale API usage and UX drift.
Cut p75 LCP by 21% in real-user monitoring across high-traffic surfaces by eliminating unused JavaScript and redrawing bundle boundaries.

work.name: Personio
highlights: Led migration of 5+ applications off the legacy frontend monolith onto the modular stack, moving the domain from a slow, debt-accumulating codebase to one where features ship reliably.
Owned frontend delivery of the central UI rebrand for my domain: 12+ stakeholders coordinated, a full-domain release with parallel UI to guarantee parity at launch.
Designed reusable geolocation and mapping infrastructure (location services and UI components) used by multiple product teams without duplicating third-party integrations.
Established a recurring frontend architecture forum to align teams on shared decisions and reduce implementation drift.
